Transfer › Instruction Bukopin › Bank › Content › Description
gopay_transfer_instructionbukopin_bank_c.$value:
How to top up GoPay:
Admin fee Rp2.000 • Min. top up Rp10.000

1. Ask the agent for a GoPay top up with KB Bank EDC Mini ATM.
2. Hand your KB Bank debit card to the agent if you have one. Otherwise, you can pay in cash.
3. Tell the agent your GoPay/Gojek registered phone number and the top up amount.
4. Enter your KB Bank PIN if you use debit card.
5. If you pay in cash, pay the amount to the agent (plus Rp2.000 top up fee).
6. Once the agent topped up your balance, make sure you've received it in your GoPay balance.
7. Keep the receipt for proof of payment.

gopay_transfer_withdrawalinstruction_atm.$value:
1. At ATM BSI, select Cardless Transaction.
2. Select Other Bank/E-Wallet.
3. Enter the GoPay e-wallet code: 914.
4. Enter your GoPay-registered phone number.
5. Enter the transaction code you received from GoPay.
6. Enter the withdrawal amount (it must match the amount processed in the GoPay app).
7. Review the withdrawal details on the screen, then select Yes to confirm.
8. If you're using a cash deposit/withdrawal machine, select your preferred cash denominations.
9. Collect your cash from the ATM to complete the transaction.
